summary: Full backend + frontend test of content-studio MVP. Created pytest suite (20 tests) covering auth, blueprint (50 atoms), article CRUD + duplicate check, LLM analyze (Gemini) creating 50 atoms, atom generation (text, auto-approve + review), edit/approve/reject/bulk-approve, dashboard stats, jobs, quotas. All 20 backend tests PASSED in 19.7s. Ran end-to-end Playwright UI flow: login -> dashboard -> create article via manual dialog -> analyze (returned analysis panel + 50 atom cards) -> atom generation (status transitioned draft -> review) -> review queue kanban (all 4 columns rendered) -> observability (job-logs + quota-list + refresh) -> logout. Every listed feature works.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing `Description`/`aria-describedby` -> accessibility warning in console. Non-blocking; add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to silence.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Radix DialogContent to fix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/atoms/{id}/regenerate simply delegates to generate_atom without resetting media/status first — old media/content remain until AI call succeeds; acceptable but could confuse UI briefly.
server.py: analyze endpoint blocks the request for the full LLM latency (5-15s). Fine for MVP but should be moved to a background job/task queue for production.
server.py list_articles projects out 'content' but the article detail endpoint returns full analysis+media as JSON; large payloads possible once many atoms exist.
AtomCard exposes atom.media inline as base64 in JSON — /api/atoms endpoints exclude media by default (good), only single atom fetch includes it (acceptable).
CORS is set to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers ignore credentials with wildcard; explicit origins would be safer if cookies are ever used (currently JWT in localStorage so OK).
server.py file is ~420 lines — still manageable, but consider splitting routes into modules as it grows.
seed_data_creation: Pytest creates & then deletes a TEST_-prefixed article per run; Playwright creates a UITEST_-prefixed article (not deleted — leftover in DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is the canonical regression suite: `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Playwright flow works end-to-end against the deployed preview URL. If retesting UI, expect atom generation to take up to ~15s for the first LLM text call. Image/audio atoms were intentionally not exercised in UI (backend already verified per main agent note).
